import sys,hashlib,os,runpy
from pathlib import Path
raw=sys.stdin.buffer.read()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2]
p=Path(sys.argv[1])
with p.open('xb') as f:
 f.write(raw); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.chmod(p,0o600)
runpy.run_path(str(p),run_name='__main__')
